method: Reviewed the full lesson against PostgreSQL 18 pg_verifybackup, pg_dump, pg_restore, and continuous archiving docs. Added explicit limitations for absent worker fencing and non-atomic cross-database snapshots. Ran the seven-test SQLite failure-boundary suite and the isolated PostgreSQL 18 logical-restore script via the hash-pinned verifier.
limitations: The PostgreSQL script restores two synthetic databases sequentially with no concurrent writes; it does not prove a coordinated cross-service point-in-time snapshot.
The SQLite fixture does not implement lease expiry, execution epochs, or stale-owner fencing.
The logical restore is not pg_verifybackup, WAL/PITR, production schema, real worker failure, RTO/RPO, or an external side-effect replay test.
The Docker image is pinned only by mutable tag, not digest. No provider was called.
